issue: The Ball buddy you pick on the name step (bucket hat on mint, the new outside file) is not the one shown on All set: the review card shows the old hand-drawn fallback (a yellow straw hat with a smile). Onboarding.jsx passes buddyAvatar(buddy), which returns { kind, id, bg }, straight to Avatar as model; AvatarArt reads model.buddy, which is undefined, so BuddyArt falls back to ART.bucket.
fix: In Onboarding.jsx line ~331 pass a real model: model={buddy ? avatarModel(buddyAvatar(buddy)) : null} (or have buddyAvatar return buddy: b.id). Check other callers of buddyAvatar that hand it to Avatar's model prop.

issue: The results card's game sticker slot under 'Oct 21 · Banker' renders as an empty cream square: the game art never draws onto the canvas, so the card shares with a blank tile.
fix: In lib/shareImage.js the game picture (pics.game, drawn at PAD,334 120x120) is missing; make sure ResultsArt passes art.game as a data URL for the outside game files and only draw the tile when the image loaded (skip the tile otherwise).

screen: Avatars on the teal backdrop (wizard, eagle, banana, viking and any buddy starting on teal)
issue: The teal backdrop (#1a3a3a) nearly vanishes on the dark card (#1e2524): the avatar loses its circle, so the eagle and banana read as cut-outs floating on the page and the wizard's ball sits on nothing.
fix: Give the teal backdrop a dark-mode token a step lighter (e.g. #2b5a55) or a 1.5px cream ring on teal circles in dark (.av-buddy[data-bg=teal] in dark: box-shadow: 0 0 0 1.5px var(--cream-line)).

screen: Ball buddies: wizard hat and traffic cone
issue: The wizard and traffic cone buddies draw the ball about 40% smaller than every other buddy (the tall hat squeezes the ball), so at 28 to 40px in seat tiles the face is a speck and the set looks inconsistent.
fix: Redraw/scale both files so the ball matches the others (ball about 70% of the 64 box, centred low) and let the hat crop past the circle top, as the chef and propeller do.

screen: icons/ball.svg (first ball on a tee) on Plan, Join and Challenge not-found screens
issue: The glossy, gradient-shaded 3D ball with a smile and a red cone tee is the old pre-brand style: no ink line, photographic shading, and in dark its shadow ellipse turns into a glowing cream disc. It sits next to the hand-drawn loneball on 'Round not found', so the three 'not found' screens use two different art styles.
fix: Swap the ball on the link screens (Join, Plan, Challenge loading and not found) for spots/loneball.svg or spots/tee.svg at the same 150 to 180px, and retire icons/ball.svg.

issue: In light the loneball's mound is the same cream as the canvas, so the ball floats on two grass tufts with no ground; in dark the mound is a bright cream slab. The drawing reads differently by theme and half-empty in light.
fix: Fill the mound with mint (#a4d4c5) or a soft ochre in the file so it reads on cream, and keep the cream sticker outline only on the ink.

issue: The two balls' arms cross over their own faces and the top of the drawing (raised hands) is clipped by the viewBox, so the slap reads as a tangle.
fix: Redraw the arms behind the bodies (or move them out to the sides) and widen the viewBox top by about 10% so the raised hands aren't cut.

screen: Game art: Nines and the hand-drawn game tiles
issue: The game tiles still drawn in code read as flat clip-art next to the brush-line outside files, and the Nines tile's number is too thin to read at the 40px it shows on cards.
fix: Bring the remaining hand-drawn game tiles into the outside-file style (brush ink line, offset fill), and make the Nines numeral a chunky ink shape at least 30% of the tile height.

issue: The ball under the albatross is a small black rounded square that reads as a stray mark or a pixel glitch, not a golf ball.
fix: Draw it as a cream ball with an ink ring and two dimple dots, about twice the size, sitting on a short mint tee line.

issue: The First tee and Doing the math cards still say they sit 'on a cream card ... the cream keeps the see-through faces from going black in dark', but the dark shots show no cream card (faces were filled and the card dropped). The sheet is the art's source of truth, so it misleads the next fixer.
fix: Update the size notes for scenes in art-manifest.js: 'shows whole, 16px in from each side, faces filled cream so no card in dark'.

screen: Every question, selected choice in dark
issue: A picked card or row fills with a muddy maroon-brown (pink at low alpha over the dark card) inside the pink border, the 'pink on dark reads brown' problem. Same on Friendly wagers only and the paywall's Yearly plan.
fix: For the selected state in dark use the normal dark card fill with only the 2px pink border and the pink check (drop the tinted background), or a neutral lift like #26302e. Shared selector for the choice card and radio rows (.ob-choice.on / .choice.on).

issue: 'Add your index' is set at the input's 22px value size, so in light it looks like a filled value, and in dark the placeholder is so faint it nearly disappears (the field looks empty and disabled).
fix: Style it as a placeholder row: 16px body, var(--mute) in both themes (check 4.5:1 on the dark field), with the plus icon in ink.

screen: Set up your next round (Get a round going), entrance
issue: 150ms into the step from All set to Get a round going the whole screen is blank canvas: the old page has gone and the new one hasn't drawn, a flash of nothing.
fix: Cross the two pages on the Stage (new page fades and slides in while All set fades out), or delay All set's exit until PlanAsk has mounted.

issue: At 150ms the question and cards are in but the cards spot is still invisible, leaving a 200px hole above the title; the art pops in after the text. (Centring itself is now right on every step: spots centred at x 390 of 780, scenes 16px in, in light and dark, mid-move included.)
fix: Start the art's fade with the page (same delay as the title) or give StepArt its own short 120ms fade with no extra delay.

issue: Scrolled, the bottom of the cards drawing slides under the fixed back button and progress bar as a hard black arc with no backdrop or fade.
fix: Give the fixed top bar the canvas colour behind it (background: var(--canvas)) or a 16px fade (mask-image on .ob-body top), so content scrolls under a surface.

issue: The avatar shows as a bare mint circle and the review card is a tall empty box while its rows stagger in, so the card draws big and then fills.
fix: Render the rows at full height with opacity 0 (so the card doesn't look empty) and preload BuddyArt before this step so the face is there on arrival.

issue: Every other step opens with a drawing; the name step and All set have none, so the flow ends on two text-only screens and the finish has no moment.
fix: Give All set a payoff drawing (the high five or the crew of buddies at 136px) above the eyebrow; the name step can show the picked buddy large once one is chosen.

issue: The disabled hint is a two-line run-on: 'To go on, add your name, then tick Friendly wagers only, then answer the age question.'
fix: List only what's still missing, one short line: 'Add your name and tick Friendly wagers to go on.'

issue: The pad's close control is a bare minus glyph at top right, which reads as 'minus' on a number pad rather than 'close', and it doesn't match the round close button on other sheets.
fix: Use the app's sheet close button (round, x icon, 44px) or drop it and rely on Done and the scrim.

issue: Four pink BIRDIE BANK stamps plus four pink struck 'You's put eight pink marks on a screen whose only tap is Continue (pink only on the one thing to tap).
fix: Stamp in ink (or teal) with the struck 'You' in mute grey; keep pink for nothing here.

issue: The trial timeline card is cut mid-row by the sticky buttons (Day 14 sliced in half) with no fade, which looks like a layout bug.
fix: Add a 24px canvas-coloured fade above the sticky footer (.paywall-foot::before linear-gradient to var(--canvas)).

screen: I'll do it later: Up next for a new organizer
issue: The tee spot in the Your first round card hangs off the card's right edge (grass cut by the card border), and scrolled it pokes out of the card top under the header.
fix: Keep the spot inside the card: right 16px, top 16px, overflow hidden on the hero, size 88px.

issue: The game title 'Skins' is in the sans at display size while every other title is the serif, and its coins icon is pink though it isn't tappable.
fix: Set the invite title in the display serif (.d) and draw the game icon in ink or use the game's sticker art.

screen: Join invite on a set-up phone
issue: Four stacked actions (Pick your seat, I'm just watching, Just keep my own score, Not now) with a big empty gap above them; two text-link and two button weights make the choice noisy, and the title is the sans while the stranger version matches.
fix: Keep Pick your seat and I'm just watching as buttons, fold 'Just keep my own score' and 'Not now' into one quiet text row, and close the gap by letting the card sit closer to the actions (no flex-grow spacer).

screen: Person card for someone not on this phone
issue: Instead of a not-found state it shows a live-looking profile called 'Someone' with an Edit button, 'All square', 'Challenge Someone' and 'Two cards for Someone? Same person as...'. Every other gone screen has an empty state.
fix: Detect the missing person and render the shared not-found layout (loneball, 'Player not found', Back to Players).

screen: Not-found screens (round, plan, join, challenge, play, trip)
issue: The gone states don't match: Round not found has a small pink 'Go back' button mid-screen, Plan and Join not found have a full-width black button pinned to the bottom, Challenge not found has its own layout, and the art switches between the hand-drawn loneball, the suitcase and the glossy 3D ball.
fix: One EmptyState for all of them: a hand-drawn spot at 150px, serif title, one line, one full-width ink button at the bottom ('Back to Up next'); pink not used.

issue: The sticky Share image / Share as text / Done footer sits on top of the 'Show scores' row, cutting off its label and toggle at first view.
fix: Add bottom padding to the sheet's scroll area equal to the footer height plus 16px, and a canvas fade above the footer.

issue: The plan's title changes from 'Golf soon?' (with a pink ball icon) to 'No day yet' after you tap In, and the eyebrow wording changes too, so it feels like a different plan. The pink eyebrow repeats the known pink-date-eyebrow problem on this card as well.
fix: Use one title for the plan in both states ('No day yet' with the leading-day line under it), drop the pink icon, and set the eyebrow in mute like the fix for the ticket cards.

screen: Plan link: Which one are you?
issue: Cody's tile has no status line while the others say In or Maybe, so the names sit at different heights across the grid.
fix: Show 'No answer' in mute on tiles without a reply (as the who's-in strip does), keeping every tile three lines.

issue: Every entry has a pink category eyebrow (GAMES AND ROUNDS, FRIENDS...), so the list is striped pink though nothing there is a tap target; each entry is also its own rounded card with gaps, unlike the hairline lists elsewhere.
fix: Category eyebrows in var(--mute); render entries as one card with hairline dividers like Settings lists.

issue: Pink is spread across the screen (Your profile link, the selected privacy option, every on toggle, Erase all data), and the Help shape Birdie Bank callout is a beige-filled card with a tiny bulb drawing squeezed into a narrow left column while every other card is white.
fix: Your profile link in ink with a chevron, toggles on in teal or ink, privacy selection with ink check; callout as a white card with the bulb at 68px centred above the text.

issue: The page title 'Status' is in a bold sans with a pink 'Birdie Bank' wordmark above, unlike every other screen's serif title, and each row repeats 'Working' under the description and the timing.
fix: Use the app header style (serif title) and the brand mark in ink; drop the repeated 'Working' line when the dot already says it, keep it only for a problem.
